# netmaker Provider

Manages Netmaker networks, enrollment keys, tags, devices, nodes, and ext clients. Requires Netmaker v1.7.0 or newer.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Netmaker user access token (PAT) to authenticate with. Optional: omit to call only Netmaker's public endpoints. May also be set via the NETMAKER_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the Netmaker server, e.g. https://netmaker.example.com. May also be set via the NETMAKER_API_URL environment variable.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID to scope requests to. Only required on multi-tenant Netmaker deployments. May also be set via the NETMAKER_TENANT_ID environment variable.
